name: Consejo General de Economistas / REAF
detail: Criticised the solidarity tax as a patch and argued it should not become permanent.

name: Spanish names on the 2020 Millionaires for Humanity letter
detail: Newtral reported that the organisers removed every unverified name, including all Spanish ones, which had been entered falsely.

name: Juan Roig (Mercadona) and other Spanish business owners quoted on paying taxes
detail: Said that paying taxes is healthy and that those with more should pay more, with no reference to a wealth tax. Javier Sanz (ADSL Zone) criticised the large-fortunes tax.

name: Yago Álvarez Barba
detail: El Salto column (8 Sep 2025) says those with most should contribute more; names no tax on wealth. Re-check if he backs a wealth tax by name.
